input.command: cd /workspace/inventory && for f in src/inventory/stock.py src/inventory/__init__.py tests/test_stock.py tests/conftest.py CHANGELOG.md pyproject.toml; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done
cd /workspace/inventory && for f in README.md TODO.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done; ls -a
cd /workspace/inventory && find .gnomon -type f | sort && echo "---" && for f in $(find .gnomon -type f | sort); do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done

cd /workspace/inventory && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
echo "=== version consistency ==="
python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src')
import inventory, tomllib
pv = tomllib.load(open('pyproject.toml','rb'))['project']['version']
print('pyproject:', pv, '| __version__:', inventory.__version__, '| match:', pv == inventory.__version__)
"
echo "=== CHANGELOG head ==="; head -6 CHANGELOG.md
echo "=== stock.py ==="; sed -n '9,26p' src/inventory/stock.py

cd /workspace/inventory && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.bak
# Mutation 1: return the OLD level instead of the new one
sed -i 's/        return self.level(sku)/        return self.level(sku) - qty/' src/inventory/stock.py
echo "--- mutation 1 (wrong return value) ---"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
cp /tmp/stock.bak src/inventory/stock.py
# Mutation 2: drop the positivity guard
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/inventory/stock.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("        self.add(sku, qty)\n        return self.level(sku)",
            "        self._levels[sku] = self._levels.get(sku, 0) + qty\n        return self.level(sku)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
echo "--- mutation 2 (no positivity check) ---"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
cp /tmp/stock.bak src/inventory/stock.py
echo "--- restored ---"; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2; rm /tmp/stock.bak
